tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open an allowed page in the workspace's ephemeral browser session, wait briefly for client rendering, and return the final URL, title, and a compact interactive snapshot. Use fetch_url or crawl_url for public pages that do not require interaction.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL on a workspace-approved domain.

wait_ms.description: Additional client-rendering settle time after the load event. Defaults to 1500 milliseconds.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Return the current page URL, title, and a refreshed bounded accessibility snapshot with element references.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector used only to scope snapshot output.

tools.name: browser_act
tools.description: Perform one bounded browser interaction using an element reference from the latest snapshot, then return the resulting URL, title, and refreshed compact snapshot.

ref.description: Element reference such as @e4. Required for element actions.

value.description: Text, key, select option, scroll direction, or wait target required by the selected action.

amount.description: Optional scroll amount in pixels or wait duration in milliseconds.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current page as a durable externally renderable workspace asset without returning image bytes to the model. Set annotate=true for numbered interactive-element labels.

name.description: Short descriptive asset name. Defaults to browser-screenshot.

selector.description: Optional element reference or CSS selector to capture.

full_page.description: Capture the full page instead of the viewport. Defaults to false.

annotate.description: Add numbered labels to interactive elements. Defaults to false.

tools.name: browser_record
tools.description: Start or stop a bounded Kernel replay of the current private browser session. Stopping removes idle agent-reasoning gaps when possible and persists one MP4 as a durable private workspace artifact without returning video bytes or provider URLs to the model. To embed it in a Helpin document, call insert_document_artifact with the returned artifact_id; writing its filename or artifact_ref into document content does not embed the video.

action.description: Start or stop the current run-scoped browser recording.

name.description: Short descriptive recording name. Used only with action=start and defaults to browser-recording.

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum recording duration. Used only with action=start and defaults to 180 seconds.

record_audio.description: Include browser audio. Used only with action=start and defaults to false.
